The *Kilañjadāyakattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative found in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Like other texts in this late canonical collection, it preserves the biographical account of an elder monk's meritorious deeds in previous births and his final attainment [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral documents five modern translations of the work across five languages [SuttaCentral].

Portions of its verses (notably segment 4.1–4.4) are also shared with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
